story.title: Codenaut
story.text:
You are a Codenaut — a navigator of code. Your ship can land on a planet only when that planet's code is in order. But the code is broken: colours washed out, sizes mixed up.

Every planet needs one small command from you. Write it, and the planet answers at once.
story.bookHint: You can go through the welcome again here and refresh how it all works.

step2.title: Two helpers
body: You have two helpers. Their names are HTML and CSS.
HTML is the builder: it puts the blocks in place.
CSS is the artist: it repaints them.

step3.title: CSS can change anything
body: CSS has many abilities: colour, size, background, borders.
To use one, you give CSS a command.

step4.title: Ready to explore?
body: Every planet waits with a new CSS ability.
First you learn colour, then size, background and borders.
Your first planet is waiting now!

colors/01-ball-color.text: {{name}} bought a ball on the Colors planet, but the seller mixed it up and gave a grey one. Make the ball green.
colors/01-ball-color.teachBody: background-color paints the inside of a shape. It is written like this: a name, then a colon, then the colour. A colon is the sign that says "and here is the value". The colour you need here is called green.
hints: You need to paint the shape, not the text. Remember which property paints the inside of a shape — its name is already written in the editor.
